acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for window rough opening repair in Daly City, look for a general contractor with experience in both framing and window installation. Verify they are licensed and insured in California. Ask for references and view examples of their previous work. Ensure they provide a detailed written estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Prioritize communication and a clear understanding of the repair process.
